verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas exposes an Editor API for programmatic asset management and a REST API, and SplatTransform provides a CLI for batch processing Gaussian splat assets (format conversion, LOD generation, etc.), which could underpin automated import pipelines. However there is no documented import-hook system, watch-folder automation, or preset-based asset processing pipeline for general assets (textures, models, audio) akin to engines with dedicated asset pipeline automation. missing for 10: documented asset import hooks/triggers, configurable import presets per asset type, batch/headless asset processing pipeline for non-splat assets, and independent evidence of technical artists using these APIs to automate imports at scale.
